subject: Fishing Pond
text: The largest fish at the Fishing Pond are located near the submerged log on the left and the reeds on the right.

evidence.quote: The biggest fish are found near the submerged log on the left side of the pond and the reeds on the right.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Leaving and re-entering the Fishing Pond causes larger fish to respawn if the pond runs low.

evidence.quote: If the pond starts running low on larger fish, then leave it and re-enter, and they will respawn.

subject: Gold Scale
text: Catching a fish weighing at least fifteen pounds and showing it to the Fishing Pond Clerk awards the Gold Scale.

evidence.quote: Once you have captured a fifteen-pound fish (minimum), return to the Clerk and show him your fish.  He'll give you the Gold Scale.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Diving all the way to the bottom of the pool in the Observatory with the Gold Scale and speaking to the scientist rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: First, use the Gold Scale to dive down all the way down to the pool of water in the corner of the room.  Speak with the scientist, and he will be so impressed, he'll give you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Rolling into the crate at the bottom of the Observatory pool while wearing Iron Boots reveals an underwater Gold Skulltula that can be killed with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Next, equip your Iron Boots and sink to the bottom of the pool of water.  Roll into the crate at the bottom of the pool to reveal the game's only underwater Gold Skulltula.  Use the Hookshot to kill it and take it's token.

subject: Water Temple Entrance
text: Shooting the diamond switch above the sealed door on the north side of the island with the Hookshot opens the gate to the Water Temple.

evidence.quote: Go to the north side of the island, and you will find a door sealed by an iron grating.  Use the Hookshot to shoot the diamond switch above the door, and the gate will unseal itself.  Enter the gate to begin the next temple.

subject: Water Temple
text: Navigating the Water Temple requires adjusting the water level to reach doors on the three different levels of the central Vertical Hallway.

evidence.quote: The center of the dungeon consists of a tall room with many doors on it's three different levels, a literal "Vertical Hallway."  The twist in this dungeon is not trying to break through the three different levels of the dungeon, as in the Deku Tree, but in trying to adjust the water level in the dungeon so that you can reach certain doors on different levels of the Vertical Hallway.

subject: Stone Block
text: Sinking to the bottom of the right-hand hallway pool with Iron Boots allows pulling back a stone block set in the wall as far as it goes.

evidence.quote: Equip the Iron Boots and sink to the bottom of the pool... Run down the hallway, and grab the stone block set in the wall directly in front of you (the path goes left and right here, but ignore this for now.  We'll get to it later on).  Grabbing the stone block, pull it back as far as it will go.

subject: Stinger
text: The Hookshot is the only weapon usable underwater and defeats Stingers in a single shot.

evidence.quote: The Hookshot is the only weapon that can be used underwater.  And lucky you, the Hookshot can also defeat Stingers in a single shot.

subject: Stinger Tunnel
text: Using the Hookshot on the targets above the spikes and ceiling pulls Link out of the water into the Compass room.

evidence.quote: Look up above the spikes to the ledge above them, and you will see a Hookshot target.  Pull yourself up to the target with the Hookshot.  Turn around and look up to the ceiling, and you will see three more Hookshot targets.  Pull yourself up to the one furthest away from you with the Hookshot, and you will pull yourself out of the water.

subject: Chest
text: Detonating a bomb near the diamond switch lowers the water pillar temporarily to allow opening the chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: In the corner, there is a diamond switch.  Drop a bomb near the switch, then run over to the pillar of water.  When the bomb explodes, the switch will activate, temporarily lowering the pillar.  Open the chest to get the Compass.

subject: Spike
text: Spike enemies can be defeated by shooting them twice with the Hookshot, once to stun and once to kill.

evidence.quote: At the bottom, you'll likely encounter several new enemies called Spikes.  To defeat these, simply shoot them twice with the Hookshot; once to stun, once to kill.

subject: Ruto
text: Entering the east tunnel on the bottom floor marked by two torches leads to an encounter with Princess Ruto.

evidence.quote: It is on the east side of the room, marked by two torches (currently unlit thanks to that pesky water level).  Run down the tunnel's hall, and you'll meet Ruto again.

subject: Water Switch One
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the Triforce plaque in the air pocket lowers the water level in the Water Temple to its lowest level.

evidence.quote: On the wall is a plaque inscribed with the Triforce.  Play Zelda's Lullaby, and the water level in the dungeon will lower.  This switch lowers the water level to the lowest level, and is therefore considered "Water Switch One."

subject: Chest
text: Defeating all Spike enemies in the Spike Room spawns a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: This room is jam-packed with Spike enemies.  Defeat them with two Hookshot attacks each, and a chest will appear.  Open it to get the Dungeon Map.

subject: Door
text: Shooting arrows through the lit torch onto the corner lanterns unseals the door in the bottom floor room where Ruto was met.

evidence.quote: Fire arrows through the torch onto the lanterns in the corners of the room to unseal the door.

subject: Shell Blade
text: Shell Blades are vulnerable when opening their mouths right before attacking, allowing them to be killed with a Hookshot shot inside.

evidence.quote: Shell Blades are invulnerable until just before they attack, when they briefly open their mouth.  When they do this, fire the Hookshot into their open mouth to kill it.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating all the Shell Blades in the Shell Blade Room causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote: Defeat all of the Shell Blades, and a chest containing a Smell Key will appear.  Small Key in hand, return through the only door to the previous room.
